text:
incident-bot: ALERT: metering.heartbeat missing for emitter token-agg-3 (eu-west-1). 5 customers received overage-notify. severity: P2. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-heartbeat
leah: oncall here — investigating
sam: looking at counts now. emitter is emitting but heartbeat pings dropped; aggregator retry logic misfired. seeing ~+12% emitted vs ledger for last 8m
julio: I can push a hotfix to the aggregator that restores heartbeat ack behavior. Will build 1.0.3-hotfix canary
leah: please canary and hold overage notifications until we confirm reconciliation. @sam can you pause notify for affected customers?
sam: pausing notifications for tag=ghost-heartbeat-171945. Command: `./control pause-notify --tag ghost-heartbeat-171945` -> OK
jordan: opening tickets and drafting customer message. affected: cust-acme, cust-zen, cust-umbrella, cust-solo, cust-ignite
leah: any immediate customer-visible charges?
sam: some overage flags queued but notifications suppressed mid-queue; worst-case a handful of customers may have received a notice before we paused. We should retract and credit if invoices posted.
jordan: drafting: "We paused billing notifications while we investigate a metering anomaly; no final charges will be applied until reconciliation completes." Will send to P0 list once sam confirms affected list
maya: finance notified — prepare CSV of customer_id, delta_tokens, timestamp window for credits
sam: queued a replay job: `batch-replay --emitter token-agg-3 --from 1719456000 --to 1719456789 --out /tmp/ghost_recon.csv` ETA ~45m
julio: canary deployment logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:15:02Z deploy: 1.0.3-hotfix -> canary
2026-03-17T10:17:40Z health: canary ok, heartbeat restored
```
leah: great, promote when safe. Sam, once replay finishes drop the CSV to /shared/billing/ghost_recon.csv and ping maya
sam: file dropped: /shared/billing/ghost_recon.csv (contains deltas + trace ids)
maya: grabbed it, will compute credits. ETA for crediting customers ~24-48h depending on payment provider
julio: promoting hotfix to 100% now (rolling 5 pods/min)
incident-bot: DEPLOY: 1.0.3-hotfix promoted -> 100% (eu-west-1) at 1719460000
incident-bot: METRIC: heartbeat restored for token-agg-3 at 1719460000; no new overage flags after pause
leah: excellent. Actions recorded: paused notifications, deployed hotfix, started replay, finance prepping credits, comms drafted/sent to affected customers. Creating incident INC-2026-042 and assigning postmortem
jordan: sent hold + follow-up comms to affected customers. template saved in /docs/incidents/INC-2026-042/comms.md :thumbsup:
sam: reconciliation job still running; will post completion time and final deltas in this thread
leah: moving to monitoring; please keep updates here until replay completes and credits issued. Thanks all.
